_metadata.description: Scheduled access and temporary pause/resume controls.

requirements.title: Access schedules control devices and groups
requirements.description: The scenario shall support bedtime, focus, guest-window, and temporary pause/resume policies for devices and groups with visible active windows and override records.

validation.notes: Verifies active/inactive schedule windows remain advisory until an approved policy apply.

Verifies the schedule CLI delegates evaluation to the generated Connect client.
